Subject: Proposal: multi-band technical deep-dive windows (US/EU/APAC) - Medilogic

Thanks again for the thoughtful discovery earlier — appreciated the context on your latency targets and the multi-region constraints. Quick recap and a concrete proposal to get the technical deep-dive on the calendar.

Recap (2 min):
- Medilogic wants a technical deep-dive focused on low-latency inference across US/EU deployments, and a rollout plan for a private VPC in Q3.
- Key success criteria: 99th pct latency <= 150ms (peak), and predictable per-token cost across spikes.

Proposed next step:
- 60–75 min technical deep-dive with Ben (serving/runtime) and Karthik (infra/ops). We'll demo a live inference profile and talk deployment/rollout patterns.

Because your team spans EMEA and the US, we suggest a rotating multi-band meeting pattern so your engineers in each region occasionally get convenient local hours. Here are three candidate windows (localized and pre-adjusted) we can rotate between for subsequent sessions: 

1) US-morning band (best for US R&D): 2026-06-04 09:00–10:15 PDT / 17:00–18:15 CEST
2) EU-afternoon band (best for EMEA): 2026-06-05 15:00–16:15 CEST / 06:00–07:15 PDT
3) APAC-evening band (best for APAC): 2026-06-06 19:00–20:15 JST / 03:00–04:15 PDT

Action items / asks for you:
- Please flag which of the three windows works for Medilogic (we can pick one this week and rotate for follow-ups).
- If you prefer specific weekdays (avoid Fridays for your infra team?), call that out.
- If Tom/Elena want your CTO on the call, we can expand the invite; Ben/Karthik can tailor the demo to include data retention and KMS flow.

I attached a short scope summary and an .ics with the three candidate slots. If any slot is obviously no-go, reply with the team’s preferred local times and I’ll send a formal invite for the chosen window.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Naomi Feldman

naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
